Overview#CranioSwift is an AI-powered system designed to revolutionize the way cranial implants are designed and manufactured. This project received an AEA Ignite Grant of $485,000 to bring it from concept to reality.
The Problem#Traditional cranial implant design is:
Time-consuming — Takes weeks to design and iterate Expensive — Requires specialized expertise Limited — Doesn’t leverage modern AI capabilities Our Solution#CranioSwift uses machine learning to:
Analyze CT scan data Generate optimized implant designs Prepare files for 3D printing Dramatically reduce design-to-production time My Role#As a key contributor to this project, I was involved in:
Technical development and validation Grant writing and securing funding Cross-disciplinary team coordination Impact#This project has the potential to:
Reduce patient waiting times Lower healthcare costs Improve surgical outcomes Make advanced medical devices more accessible Status#🚧 In Development — Stay tuned for updates!
title: CranioSwift

Hi, I’m Michael 👋#I’m Zaimao Peng (彭在茂), but most people call me Michael. I’m a Postdoctoral Research Fellow at Monash University, working at the intersection of biomedical engineering, materials science, and emerging technologies.
What I Do#My work spans across:
3D Bioprinting — Developing advanced bioinks and printing strategies for tissue engineering Rheological Characterization — Expert in complex fluid behavior (I train people on the Anton Paar MCR702e!) AI in Healthcare — CranioSwift project: AI-powered cranial implant design Cross-disciplinary Collaboration — Bridging academia, industry, and international partnerships My Journey#Born in China, educated across two continents through the Monash-Central South University joint program. I’ve worn many hats: researcher, trainer, coordinator, mentor, and now — builder of things that matter.
Beyond the Lab#When I’m not in the lab, you’ll find me:
🐱 Hanging out with my ragdoll cat Lulu 📚 Reading about technology and entrepreneurship 🌏 Exploring ideas at the intersection of East and West 🛠️ Building side projects and learning new skills Let’s Connect#I’m always interested in collaborations, conversations, and new ideas. Feel free to reach out!
